scenes.label: 500 se kya hoga?

visual.prompt: Night, a middle-class Indian dining table, BHAI in a hoodie looking at a glowing phone notification, PAPA in a kurta laughing and waving an FD receipt, MUMMY in a saree pouring chai, warm yellow light

scenes.vo: 500 rupaye mahine ki SIP se 20 saal mein kya banega? Yahi sawaal Papa ne dinner table par Bhai se poocha, aur thodi hasi bhi udaayi. Bhai ke phone par abhi message aaya tha, SIP debited. Papa ne apni FD ki receipt hilaayi aur bole, beta, safe toh yeh hai.

visual.prompt: Close view of BHAI at the dinner table, shoulders dropped, staring at his phone with a confused, embarrassed face, PAPA blurred in the background smiling

scenes.vo: Bhai chup ho gaya. Use khud nahi pata tha ki 500 se kya hoga. Bas office mein sabne kaha tha, SIP shuru kar do. Aur yahi baat sabse khatarnak hai, jab hum kuch karte hain, bina samjhe ki kyun kar rahe hain.

visual.prompt: A wide drawn view of an Indian city at dusk with thousands of tiny glowing coins rising from apartment windows and flowing like a river towards a big building, sense of scale and wonder

scenes.vo: Lekin Bhai akela nahi hai. AMFI yaani mutual fund companies ki sanstha, uske hisaab se September 2026 mein sirf SIP se 32,490 crore rupaye aaye. Sirf usi mahine mein. Socho, itna paisa chhote chhote installments mein, chupchaap market mein ja raha hai.

visual.prompt: A crowded Indian neighbourhood street seen from above, many small homes with lit windows, in each window a young person holding a phone and an older person looking doubtful, evening

scenes.vo: Aur yeh paisa kuch ameeron ka nahi hai. Usi mahine 10 crore se zyada SIP accounts mein paisa gaya. Matlab har gali, har mohalle mein koi Bhai hai, jiska paisa kata, aur jiske ghar mein koi Papa poochh raha hai, isse kya hoga?

visual.prompt: SG, early forties, beard, striped shirt, standing beside the dinner table as narrator, one hand raised as if counting questions, the family looking up at him curiously, warm light

scenes.vo: Toh aaj hum isi dinner table ke sawaalon ka jawab dhoondhenge. 500 ki SIP se 20 saal mein asal mein kya banta hai? Market gire toh SIP band karna sahi hai ya galat? Aur expense ratio naam ki cheez chupke se aapka kitna khaati hai?

visual.prompt: A friendly drawn diagram-like scene: many small hands dropping coins into a big common pot, a team of people in office clothes carefully placing the coins into baskets of company buildings, soft daylight

scenes.vo: Par pehle basic baat. SIP yaani Systematic Investment Plan. Matlab har mahine tay tareekh par, tay rakam, aapke bank se kat kar mutual fund mein chali jaati hai. Mutual fund yaani bahut saare logon ka paisa ikattha, jise expert team shares ya bonds mein lagaati hai.

visual.prompt: BHAI relaxing on a sofa on a Sunday afternoon, phone face down beside him, playing a video game, carefree expression, sunlight through the window

scenes.vo: Aapko roz market dekhna nahi padta. Na yeh sochna padta hai ki aaj kharidoon ya kal. Bhai ke liye yahi sabse badi suvidha thi. Salary aayi, SIP kati, baaki mahina normal. Isiliye usne kabhi sawaal hi nahi kiya ki andar ho kya raha hai.

scenes.label: 20 saal ka hisaab

visual.prompt: SG as narrator walking with BHAI towards a small kirana shop in a busy lane, SG pointing at a crate of red tomatoes, morning light

scenes.vo: Chaliye, ab hisaab samajhte hain. Aur iske liye Bhai ko kiraane ki dukaan par le chalte hain. Kyunki SIP ka sabse bada raaz, rupee cost averaging, wahan tamatar ke daam mein chhupa hai. Haan, tamatar.

visual.prompt: SHOPKEEPER at a kirana counter weighing tomatoes on a scale, puzzled raised eyebrow, BHAI handing over the same folded notes calmly, a small bag of tomatoes on one side and a big bag on the other

scenes.vo: Maan lo Bhai har hafte tamatar par tay paisa kharch karta hai. Kilo tay nahi, paisa tay. Jab tamatar mehnga hota hai, usi paise mein kam aate hain. Jab sasta hota hai, zyada aate hain. Shopkeeper hairaan hai, yeh ladka kabhi kilo nahi poochta.

visual.prompt: A drawn panel of a seesaw: on one side a rising price arrow, on the other side small glowing unit coins piling up more when the arrow goes down, BHAI watching with growing understanding

scenes.vo: SIP bilkul aise hi kaam karti hai. Mutual fund mein aap units kharidte ho. Unit yaani fund ka chhota sa hissa, jiska daam roz badalta hai, isko NAV kehte hain. Market upar, toh 500 mein kam units. Market neeche, toh 500 mein zyada units.

visual.prompt: BHAI sitting at a desk at night, drawing a wavy line on a notebook and placing coins along its dips, a lamp lighting his face, a small smile of realisation

scenes.vo: Isko kehte hain rupee cost averaging. Yaani lambe samay mein aapki unit ki average keemat apne aap sambhal jaati hai, kyunki girte market mein aapne zyada units utha li. Aapko andaaza lagana hi nahi pada ki sasta kab hai.

visual.prompt: PAPA at the dinner table stacking small bundles of notes into a neat tower, counting with his finger, serious focused face, BHAI watching

scenes.vo: Ab asli sawaal. 500 rupaye mahina, 20 saal tak. Aapki jeb se kul kitna gaya? Tata Mutual Fund ke hisaab se seedha 1.2 lakh rupaye. Yeh aapka apna paisa hai, jise principal kehte hain. Isme abhi koi kamaai nahi judi.

visual.prompt: The tower of notes on the table magically growing taller like a plant, glowing softly, PAPA leaning back in surprise, MUMMY covering her mouth with a hand

scenes.vo: Ab Tata Mutual Fund ka hi illustration dekhiye. Agar saalana return lagbhag 11 percent maan lein, toh yeh paisa 20 saal mein lagbhag 4.30 lakh ban sakta hai. Dhyan dijiye, maan lein. Yeh andaaza hai, vaada nahi.

visual.prompt: PAPA wearing reading glasses, pressing buttons on an old calculator, frowning in disbelief, a snowball rolling down a hill growing bigger drawn faintly behind him

scenes.vo: Papa ne calculator uthaya. Unhe yakeen nahi hua ki paisa itna kaise badha. Yahi compounding hai, yaani kamaai par kamaai. Shuru ke saalon mein dheere, aakhri saalon mein tezi se. Sabse zyada badhat aakhri hisse mein hi dikhti hai.

visual.prompt: BEHEN in office wear, arms crossed, one eyebrow raised, sceptical half-smile, pointing at the growing note tower, BHAI looking slightly worried

scenes.vo: Lekin Behen ne turant pakda. Usne kaha, 11 percent har saal kaun dega? Market toh aisa seedha nahi chalta. Aur yeh sawaal bilkul sahi hai. Asli zindagi mein return seedhi line nahi hota, wahan achhe saal bhi aate hain, aur bure bhi.

scenes.label: Achha dashak, flat dashak

visual.prompt: SG as narrator opening a big old book whose pages show a long winding mountain road, BEHEN peeking over his shoulder, soft library light

scenes.vo: Behen ke sawaal ka jawab history mein hai. Toh chaliye, dekhte hain market ne pichhle saalon mein asal mein kya kiya. Aur yahan naya shabd aayega, Nifty 50 TRI. Ghabraiye mat, yeh utna mushkil nahi jitna sunne mein lagta hai.

visual.prompt: A giant friendly thermometer standing among tall company buildings, small coins dropping from the buildings back into the thermometer, BHAI and BEHEN looking up at it

scenes.vo: Nifty 50 yaani desh ki 50 badi companies ka index, market ka thermometer jo batata hai sab kaisa chal raha hai. TRI yaani Total Return Index, jisme companies ka diya dividend bhi wapas jod diya jaata hai. Yaani poori kamaai ka hisaab.

visual.prompt: BEHEN reading a report on her laptop at night, her sceptical face slowly softening into thoughtfulness, a mountain-road line drawn rising gently on the wall behind

scenes.vo: PrimeInvestor ke hisaab se, February 2026 tak ke 20 saal mein Nifty 50 TRI ne saalana lagbhag 12.44 percent diya. Matlab Tata wala andaaza hawa mein nahi tha. History usse milti julti hai. Par yahan bhi likha hai, pichhla return aage bhi mile, zaroori nahi.

visual.prompt: A split drawn landscape: on the left a steep green hill with a happy runner sprinting up, on the right a long flat dusty road with a tired walker, same sky above

scenes.vo: Par is average ke andar kahani chhupi hai. Kuch dashak aise aate hain jab market tez bhaagta hai, aur lagta hai paisa ped par ugta hai. Aur kuch aise aate hain jab saalon tak market wahin ka wahin rehta hai. Isko flat dashak samjhiye.

visual.prompt: A long winding road drawn across a wide valley, with storm clouds over some stretches, flat plains in others, and sunny climbs in between, a small figure walking all the way

scenes.vo: Value Research ne January 2000 se January 2026 tak, yaani 26 saal ka hisaab dekha. Poore daur ka saalana return lagbhag 11.4 percent nikla. Aur is daur mein crash bhi aaye, mandi bhi aayi, aur lambe flat saal bhi.

visual.prompt: BHAI slumped on his bed looking at a flat line on his phone screen, bored and frustrated, PAPA walking past the door holding FD receipts with a smug smile

scenes.vo: Ab socho, agar Bhai ne SIP aise waqt shuru ki jab market flat chal raha hai. Saal pe saal statement dekhta hai, paisa wahin ka wahin. Woh sochta hai, yeh sab bekaar hai. Papa ki FD toh kam se kam badh rahi hai.

visual.prompt: A drawn treasure chest quietly filling with small glowing unit coins during a grey rainy season, then the sun breaking through and the coins shining brightly, BHAI smiling

scenes.vo: Lekin yahi flat saal SIP waale ke liye chhupa tohfa hain. Kyunki un saalon mein uske 500 rupaye har mahine sasti units kharid rahe hain. Jab baad mein achha daur aata hai, toh yahi sasti units sabse zyada kamaati hain.

visual.prompt: SG sitting at the dinner table with BEHEN and BHAI, drawing a zigzag line on a paper napkin, calm explaining expression, chai cups on the table

scenes.vo: Isliye 20 saal ka koi bhi andaaza, chahe kitna bhi achha lage, seedhi line nahi hai. Yeh achhe aur bure saalon ka mila jula nateeja hai. Aur pichhla return aage bhi milega, yeh koi nahi keh sakta. Bas itna samajh aata hai ki tike rehne waalon ko average milta hai.

scenes.label: Crash aur chhupa kharcha

visual.prompt: SG as narrator standing in a dim living room, serious face, behind him a stormy window with lightning, the family silhouettes tense on the sofa

scenes.vo: Ab sabse dardnaak hissa. Woh din jab market girta hai, aur ghar ka mahaul badal jaata hai. Yahi woh moment hai jahan sabse zyada log galti karte hain, aur us galti ka bill saalon baad aata hai.

visual.prompt: Late night, BHAI sitting on the edge of his bed lit only by his phone showing a sharp red falling graph, a TV in the background flashing red, his face pale and anxious

scenes.vo: Raat ka waqt hai. Bhai ka phone baar baar baj raha hai. News channel chilla raha hai, market dhadaam. Bhai app kholta hai, aur uski SIP laal rang mein dikh rahi hai. Jitna daala tha, ab usse kam dikh raha hai.

visual.prompt: MUMMY in a saree holding BHAI's arm with a worried face, PAPA nodding firmly beside her, BHAI's thumb hovering over his phone, night, tense kitchen light

scenes.vo: Mummy ghabra jaati hain. Kehti hain, beta band kar de, jo bacha hai nikaal le. Papa bhi haan mein haan milaate hain. Unke hisaab se yeh bilkul samajhdari hai. Aag lagi hai, toh ghar se bahar niklo.

visual.prompt: Close-up of BHAI's finger about to press a button on his phone, sweat on his forehead, a small drawn boat sinking in his imagination above his head

scenes.vo: Aur sach kahein toh yeh dar galat nahi lagta. Insaan ka dimaag nuksaan ko kamaai se zyada mehsoos karta hai. Laal rang dekhte hi lagta hai ki aur ruke toh sab doob jaayega. Isliye Bhai SIP rokne ka button dabaane hi wala hai.

visual.prompt: A shop with a big festive sale decoration and shelves full of goods, BHAI running out of the door while other calm shoppers fill their bags, SHOPKEEPER looking confused

scenes.vo: Lekin ab rupee cost averaging yaad kijiye. Market gira matlab units sasti ho gayi. Yahi toh woh waqt hai jab 500 rupaye sabse zyada units kharidte hain. SIP band karna matlab sale shuru hote hi dukaan se bhaag jaana.

visual.prompt: BHAI standing at the bottom of a hill holding a few coins, looking up regretfully at people at the top in sunshine, he is starting the climb again alone

scenes.vo: Aur jo nikal gaya, woh aksar tab wapas aata hai jab market phir se upar ja chuka hota hai. Yaani usne sasta becha, aur baad mein mehnga khareeda. Crash ne nahi, ghabrahat ne us nuksaan ko asli bana diya.

visual.prompt: A tiny sneaky mouse quietly nibbling at the corner of BHAI's jar of coins at night while the whole family sleeps, moonlight through the window

scenes.vo: Ab doosra chor, jo shor nahi karta. Expense ratio. Yaani fund ko chalane ka saalana kharcha, jo aapke paise mein se hi, percent mein, chupchaap katta rehta hai. Aapko alag se bill nahi aata, isliye kisi ko dikhta bhi nahi.

visual.prompt: BEHEN at a desk comparing two jars of coins with a magnifying glass, one jar with a small nibbled corner, one with a bigger bite, focused curious face, daylight

scenes.vo: Is kharche ki seema tay hai. Business Today ke hisaab se index funds aur ETF ke liye base seema ab 0.9 percent hai. Index fund yaani jo bas Nifty jaisa index copy karta hai, isliye usme kharcha aam taur par kam hota hai.

visual.prompt: The snowball from earlier rolling downhill but with small pieces chipping off at every turn, BEHEN pointing at the chips, BHAI's eyes widening

scenes.vo: Ab 0.9 percent chhota lagta hai. Par yeh har saal, poore jama paise par katta hai, 20 saal tak. Aur jo kata, uspe aage ki compounding bhi gayi. Isliye fund chunte waqt return ke saath expense ratio bhi dekhiye, yeh dabe paon aapka hissa khaata hai.

scenes.label: Tax, galti aur aage kya

visual.prompt: An older, slightly grey BHAI years later standing at a bank counter, BANK UNCLE smiling behind the counter, SG as narrator standing at the side with a knowing look

scenes.vo: Ab maan lo Bhai ne himmat rakhi, SIP chalti rahi, aur 20 saal baad paisa nikaalne ka waqt aaya. Kya poora paisa uska? Yahan aata hai tax, aur iske bina koi bhi hisaab adhoora hai.

visual.prompt: BANK UNCLE behind the counter drawing a line on a paper with a pencil, explaining patiently, older BHAI listening closely, bright afternoon bank interior

scenes.vo: Equity mutual fund ko saal bhar se zyada rakh kar becho, toh jo munafa hota hai use long term capital gain kehte hain, yaani LTCG. PIB ke hisaab se har financial year mein 1.25 lakh rupaye tak ka LTCG tax free hai.

visual.prompt: Older BHAI at home dividing coins into several small labelled-looking pouches without text, placing them on a calendar-like wooden shelf, calm planning face

scenes.vo: Usse upar ke munafe par 12.5 percent tax lagta hai. Isi wajah se samajhdar log aakhri saal mein saara paisa achanak nahi nikaalte. Zaroorat ke hisaab se thoda thoda nikaalte hain, taaki har saal ki chhoot ka faayda mile.

visual.prompt: SG facing a mirror in which his reflection is a nervous young man reaching for a stop button, SG gently shaking his head, soft evening light

scenes.vo: Toh sabse badi galti kya hai? 500 ko chhota samajhna nahi. Galti hai, flat saalon mein bore ho kar ruk jaana, crash mein ghabra kar nikal jaana, aur kharche ko kabhi na dekhna. SIP ka dushman market nahi, hamari aadat hai.

visual.prompt: BHAI and BEHEN sitting together on a balcony with chai, calmly reading a statement on a tablet, the city glowing at sunset behind them, relaxed confident mood

scenes.vo: Toh kya kar sakte hain? Shuru karke bhool jaane ke bajaye, har saal statement dekhiye, ghabraane ke liye nahi, samajhne ke liye. Expense ratio dekhiye. Aur jab salary badhe, SIP bhi thodi badhaiye. Yeh investment advice nahi hai, bas samajhne ka tareeka hai.

visual.prompt: A drawn balance scale on the dinner table with a small brave heart, a tiny mouse and a cloud on it, SG resting his hand beside it thoughtfully

scenes.vo: Aur haan, 20 saal ka nateeja koi tay number nahi hai. Andaaza yahi kehta hai ki aapka jama principal kai guna ho sakta hai. Par asal number teen cheezon par nahi, bas aapki himmat, kharche aur market ke mood par tika hai.

visual.prompt: Night at the same dinner table, PAPA holding BHAI's phone close to his face with curious wide eyes, FD receipt loosely in his other hand, BHAI grinning, MUMMY smiling with chai

scenes.vo: Dinner table par wapas chalte hain. Papa ab bhi FD ki receipt pakde hain, par is baar woh hans nahi rahe. Woh Bhai ka phone le kar dekh rahe hain, aur dheere se poochte hain, beta, yeh SIP kaise shuru karte hain?

visual.prompt: SG standing by the dinner table turning towards the viewer with a warm smile, the family in the background chatting, an FD receipt and a phone lying side by side on the table

scenes.vo: Ab aapse sawaal. Aapne kabhi market girne par SIP roki hai? Haan ya na, comments mein likhiye. Aur agle video mein baat karenge FD aur PPF ki, ki jo safe lagta hai, woh mehngai ke baad asal mein kitna bachata hai.

sheet.summary: Unexpected claim deductions and rejections often stem from hidden policy fine print like room-rent caps, proportionate deductions, and disease-specific waiting periods. Relying solely on basic employer group cover leaves salaried households vulnerable during job transitions or catastrophic illnesses. Because out-of-pocket medical expenses account for over 43 percent of total health spending, an inadequate claim payout can instantly derail monthly household budgets, emergency funds, and long-term mutual fund SIPs.
